title: nothing can separate us

verses.text: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.
For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor principalities, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers,
neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

caption:
Nothing that comes at you today has the power to separate you from God's love.

Paul writes out the whole list. Death and life, angels and powers, the present and the future, height and depth, anything else in all creation. Not one of them can reach the love that holds you in Christ Jesus.

Romans 8:37, 8:38 and 8:39 (BSB)

Save this for the day the list feels long.
Send it to someone carrying a lot right now.
